text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Palestinian President Arafat leaves Morocco after meeting King Hassan.
- Justice Minister Abderrahman Amalu inaugurates economic training for Moroccan lawyers ahead of the setting up of trade courts.
- Euromoney forum held last week in Rabat with more than 300 foreign experts is more a publicity campaign than effective steps for more investments.
- Yasser Arafat's visit to Morocco focused on Arab worries over Israeli Prime Minister Benyamin Netanyahu plans to establish settlements in East Jerusalem.
- PLO leader Yasser Arafat and King Hassan to convene meeting of Jerusalem Committee.
- Morocco and Yemen sign agreement to encourage investments in both countries.
